description: Defines the CookieOptions class and nested SameSiteCookieContext class, including enums and metadata related to cookie security contexts and behaviors in the Chromium project.

classes.name: CookieOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for cookie access, including security context, HttpOnly exclusion, and first-party context.

classes.name: SameSiteCookieContext
classes.description: Represents the context for SameSite cookie policies, including trust level and downgrade metadata.

methods.name: MakeAllInclusive
methods.description: Creates a CookieOptions instance that includes all cookies, including HttpOnly and SameSite cookies, without updating access time.

methods.name: SetContextTypesForTesting
methods.description: Sets context types for testing purposes.

methods.name: CompleteEquivalenceForTesting
methods.description: Checks if two SameSiteCookieContext instances are completely equivalent, including metadata.
